# Vox
[color=#ffa500]Warning! This species is not recommended for beginners due to its lethal oxygen allergy![/color]
Vox breathe nitrogen, and [color=#ffa500]oxygen is toxic to them.[/color] Unfortunately, stations are full of oxygen, so vox must almost always use an internal nitrogen supply to avoid lethal exposure.
Vox always spawn with working nitrogen breathing equipment. Their survival box contains a spare breath mask and an emergency nitrogen tank.
In addition to regular food, vox can safely eat snack wrappers, banana peels, eggshells, and raw meat. They also enjoy drinking welding fuel.
Vox [color=#1e90ff]slowly recover from small amounts of poison damage[/color] on their own, as long as they do not exceed 20 points of poison damage. This lets them breathe station air for up to thirty seconds without lasting harm, giving them time to quickly eat, drink, take pills, and so on. Recovering from 30 seconds of oxygen exposure takes about two minutes. If their health does not start improving within a minute of exposure, they should seek medical attention.
Vox deal slashing damage with unarmed attacks.
